method.name: real-review bounded evolution
method.summary: Convert real wins and losses into bounded scoring rules, hard constraints, and protected brave behaviors before publishing.
principles: Learn from winning matches and losing matches.
Fatal risks are hard constraints, not small penalties.
Do not let defensive fixes remove star tempo, lane control, or pressure fire.
Keep one rollback baseline and one coherent hypothesis per cycle.
Use live target pools and real challenge batches for ladder evaluation; simulations are only safety checks.
Do not patch from a single fresh loss unless it is a reproducible hard constraint; cluster real replay tags before changing code.

boundedAxes.purpose: Handle active bullets, aimed shots, hidden shooters, overload lanes, skill traps, and own bombs before value actions.
Use boost for valuable safe star routes without wasting it on short routes or overshooting the star.
Preserve safe adjacent and near-star pickups before lower-value pressure, grass, or patrol actions.
requiredTests: safe adjacent star before ordinary clear fire
boost star-control next to a collectible star

boundedAxes.purpose: Choose between boost, direct pickup, star control, interception, pressure, and lane exits by frame value instead of fixed-order side effects.
requiredTests: action priority in an explicit strategy pipeline
boost star-control override urgent bullet danger
keeps moving toward a close contested star
does not shield-chase a clearly lost star race

boundedAxes.purpose: Avoid corner drift, empty line holds, dead grass, and no-value fallback actions after a star window.
requiredTests: patrol does not fire dirt when it is not opening a star route
re-centers from a low-value edge patrol
does not spend shield on a low-value dangerous adjacent star

protectedBehaviors: Keep safe immediate star pickup when no hard danger exists.
Preserve safe adjacent star pickup before ordinary fire, grass, interception, or pressure movement.
Do not cast boost while a current bullet lane is urgent.
Boost may be used for valuable safe mid or long folded star routes, especially against mobile opponents or when not leading.
Do not spend boost on short routes that would skip or overshoot the star.
When boosted next to a star, hold or turn for a controlled pickup instead of double-stepping through it.
Boost star-control must yield to an adjacent collectible star.
Do not let boost star-control override urgent bullet danger.
Hard danger still outranks stars, grass, pressure fire, bombs, and ordinary pathing.
Same-row or same-column gunline decisions should be resolved by frame cost before star chasing or turning in place.
Do not idle in grass unless it controls a star line or pressure lane.
Strategic grass control may outrank ordinary star pathing only when the grass controls a star line or pressure lane.
Patrol must not fire dirt unless it opens the current star route.
Visual speech may add flavor, but it must not change action selection.

publishRequires: pre-publish code quality and strategy-conflict review
npm run simulate with AGENTANK_SHIELD_KEY loaded
shield-main challenge dry-run before any real challenge
explicit user confirmation before real challenge execution
stopAfter: new failure not covered by current bounded axis

driftRules: Do not convert one fresh loss directly into code unless the reviewed hard constraint is reproducible or part of a clustered failure axis.
Do not add a new tactical axis without a required regression test.
Do not optimize only from losses; preserve at least one winning behavior.
Do not publish a candidate whose protected behavior tests fail.
Do not keep raw replay dumps as persistent repo context.
Visual speech may add flavor, but it must not change action selection.
Every reviewed replay must emit preserve, fix, hard-constraint, and brave-baseline buckets.
Use real challenge batches as the decision signal; simulation results are safety checks only.
